== Description ==

[[Steve Harpster]] (left, black T-shirt, khaki shorts, and white hair) playing an opponent with wavy hair and glasses (right, unlabeled) at a table in the hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; background faces unlabeled.
